SELECT b.id bank_id,s.name subject_name,count(q.id) question_count,count(a.id) active_question_count, count(f.question_id) answered_count,count(f.question_id) FILTER(WHERE f.judgment='CORRECT') correct_count,count(f.question_id) FILTER(WHERE f.judgment='WRONG') wrong_count,count(f.question_id) FILTER(WHERE f.judgment='WRONG' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM totals t WHERE t.question_id=f.question_id AND t.wrong_count>0)) wrong_book_count0 answered_count,0 correct_count,0 wrong_count,0 wrong_book_count FROM question_bank b JOIN subject s ON s.id=b.subject_id LEFT JOIN question q ON q.bank_id=b.id AND NOT q.is_group LEFT JOIN active_question a ON a.id=q.id LEFT JOIN facts f ON f.question_id=a.id AND f.rn=1 WHERE b.id IN GROUP BY b.id,s.name
SELECT a.id,a.bank_id,coalesce(m.college_id,a.college_id) college_id,a.major_id,a.grade FROM bank_category a LEFT JOIN major m ON m.id=a.major_id WHERE a.bank_id IN ORDER BY a.id
SELECT bank_id,admin_id FROM bank_maintainer WHERE bank_id IN ORDER BY admin_id
